projects.shape: explicit dependency injection with stateful filesystem binding

cost.authoring_wall_measurement: earliest project source mtime to accepted evidence write

earned_findings: The real-filesystem rung exposed and fixed a staging-file leak after replace failure.
The adapter duplicates expected revision because generated cases lack a normalized application/effect command plan.

projects.shape: legacy requests.Session.send monkey patch plus passive socket guard

cost.authoring_wall_measurement: shared elapsed wall clock from recorded start to accepted evidence

earned_findings: The four-scenario hand baseline killed the entire catalog, so this catalog shows zero incremental mutation-score value.
urllib and raw sockets bypass Session.send; the separate passive socket guard blocked both probes.
Recorded replay resolves a virtualenv interpreter symlink and needs an explicit site-packages import root.
The generated port protocol is available, but this self-installing provider binds None and does not implement that port.

projects.shape: four explicit, correlated stateful providers with shared order journal

cost.authoring_wall_measurement: shared concurrent wall clock since preregistration; not person effort

earned_findings: Terminal-state cases omit order, cardinality, duplicate-send rejection, and response-class plans, so providers currently reimplement semantic oracle decisions.
The project hand-built an immutable correlated bundle, monotonic shared journal, and manual snapshot/refinement composition that should have a generic point-scoped utility.
A direct datetime read bypasses ClockPort; direct network access needs a separate passive guard.
Twelve kills at iteration zero demonstrate fixed-catalog oracle coverage, not later-representative fuzz sensitivity.

limitations: Killed mutants stop after the first complete failing iteration; only controls exercise every deterministic representative.
The three hand baselines have different scenario breadth, so the 30/36 aggregate is descriptive rather than a pooled statistical control.
Authoring wall clocks have different measurement scopes and include concurrent elapsed time; LOC and edit/run counts are the more comparable cost signals.
The experiments validate a fixed preregistered Python catalog, not exhaustive fuzzing, shrinking, arbitrary TLA+ response synthesis, universal effect interception, or service equivalence.

recommendations.detail: Generate response class, effect order/cardinality, semantic command fields, and projection obligations from modeled transition annotations rather than duplicating them by hand. Add a generic point-scoped correlated bundle, monotonic journal, and snapshot composition utility while leaving domain assertions project-owned. Providers should still choose concrete bytes, paths, exceptions, headers, and opaque values. Do not generate a byte-level per-call response script.

recommendations.item: Preserve the originating interpreter environment in replay commands
recommendations.detail: Record the virtualenv interpreter path without resolving its symlink and add a dependency-bearing replay regression.

recommendations.item: Add collect/continue campaigns and data-dependent mutants
recommendations.detail: Keep exact first-failure replay, but optionally continue after discovery so representative breadth and time-to-detection are measurable.

recommendations.item: Standardize bypass declarations and stronger isolation rungs
recommendations.detail: Treat monkey patches as compatibility-only, ship passive guard probes, and offer process/network or real-service rungs when the boundary matters.
Standardize only the normalized semantic fields proven common across more domains; a universal wire-response DSL would move implementation detail into TLA+ and overfit these examples.
Implement JVM-native typed providers and an external entrypoint protocol after semantic plans and replay provenance stabilize. Do not route Java effects through Python as the default architecture.
